boundaries: Native Causal Step original source is unordered rank-k hyperedges with bit-mutation and fixed sampled test ranks, NOT any of these external theories.
No assumption that quantum Hilbert states, spacetime metrics, energy, entropy law, gauge fields or preselected dimension are primitive.
The scope is mechanism-level structural similarity, not document title or visually similar graph diagrams.
Dynamic particle/field/emergent examples from condensed matter may be physically proven *within an already quantum Hamiltonian*, without being evidence for a new pregeometric quantum theory.
Some author/institution project reports contain non-peer-reviewed strong physics claims; those remain explicitly unqualified.
All sources and prior literature need source-bounded verification before use as theorem input.
No new Causal Step simulation or source-rule change authorized by this literature inventory.
